## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `91fbde288442373ea5a36341ba83dea58172938c`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/conversions/refused-shapes.ts, packages/spec/src/conversions/stored.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.object-extension-field-patch-key-grammar-refused.ts + packages/spec/src/conversions/walk.ts (`mapCollection`), packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts (the seven conversions that walk `objectExtensions[]`), packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts (`ObjectExtensionSchema.fieldPatches`, `FieldNameKeySchema`, the `__c` and replaced-field refinements), packages/spec/src/meta-spelling/manifest-collection-spelling.ts and meta-url-data.generated.ts (the shared maps and the URL fold), packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-object-extension-item.ts (`registrableObjectExtension`, the INVALID_METADATA the reason cites), packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts (`resyncStoredObjectExtensions` ~L2005-2035, the `--stored` pass ~L16500-16770), packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-stored-item-conversion.ts and packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.ts (the rehydration seams), packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-stored-overlay-types.ts (`isNonCanonicalStoredType`), scripts/check-stack-collection-maps.mjs (the `objectExtensions` waivers), scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs (the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class), .changeset/29366-field-patches-key-grammar.md and .changeset/29554-stored-object-extension-rows.md (read to judge ② and ③, not reviewed).

Inputs read: card #29554 body and all three comments (triage, claim, os-dev-report); PR #29589 body, file list (7 files) and the net diff against merge base `dbca3ef0`; the check-runs on the head at two polls. Not read: the dispatch order, the seat's own conclusions.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **`applyConversionsToStoredItem('object_extension', row)` now wraps the row as `objectExtensions: [row]` and replays the full chain** (`stored.ts` L63-85, `STORED_ONLY_COLLECTIONS`). Verified: `PLURAL_TO_SINGULAR` and `SINGULAR_TO_PLURAL` (`manifest-collection-spelling.ts`) carry neither `object_extension` nor `objectExtensions`, so before this line the lookup at L146 found no collection and returned the row by reference. The card's premise holds in the tree. **Right.**
2. **The shared maps are not widened; the stored-only map is the right home.** `check-stack-collection-maps.mjs` waives `objectExtensions` as `missing` on `PLURAL_TO_SINGULAR` (L537-543: "merge into their target rather than registering as a type") and on four other maps (L498, L569, L616, L716). Adding it to the shared map would advertise a named-item collection to registration and the authoring lint, exactly the #19620 argument for `translation`. **Right.** (The waiver's reason text at L539, "there is no singular metadata-type name to map to", is dated since ADR-0146 D10 minted `object_extension`; the waiver itself stays right. Wording only, outside scope, the dev noted it.)
3. **No plural row spelling is mapped.** `meta-url-data.generated.ts` L51-52 folds `object_extensions` and `objectExtensions` to `object_extension`, and L69 lists `object_extension` as canonical, so `isNonCanonicalStoredType` is true for both plurals and the `--stored` pass reports such a row `skipped` (protocol.ts ~L16575) before its body is read. The stored.test control pins both plurals pass through by reference. **Right.**
4. **Every rehydration seam that reads `object_extension` rows now serves converted bodies.** `convertStoredItem` (protocol-stored-item-conversion.ts L58-73) is called with `row.type` by the list reads and by `resyncStoredObjectExtensions` (protocol.ts L2030) before `registrableObjectExtension` parses the body; `database-loader.ts` `rowToData` L878-890 does the same for the DB loader. Consequence: a stored extension carrying a shape the strict `FieldSchema` refuses at 18 but a retired conversion rewrites (a `12:00Z` time default, `reference_to`, a bare `unique: true` index, a malformed `scale`, a `currencyConfig.precision`) used to fail the resync with INVALID_METADATA and now registers canonical, as an `object` row already did. This is the fix the card asked for, and it is wire-visible only as the already-published `ConversionNotice` shape. **Right.**
5. **Side effects on upgrade, measured against `registry.ts`.** Exactly seven conversions walk `objectExtensions[]`: `field-malformed-scale-precision-removed` (L2588), `declared-index-unique-scope` (L3310), `time-default-utc-suffix-dropped` (L4531), `field-column-lists-canonicalized` (L5112), `field-reference_to-to-reference` (L9054), `currency-config-dynamic-default-currency-removed` (L14987), `currency-config-precision-removed` (L15094). All seven are `retiredFromLoadPath: true`, idempotent, walk `fields`/`indexes` by key (never by `name`, which an extension lacks), and each carries an `objectExtensions` fixture of its own: they were written for this row and never reached it. No conversion keys on the extension's `extend`, none dedups a one-element collection, and no EXISTING `REFUSED_STORED_SHAPES` detector walks `objectExtensions` (they walk `objects`, `dashboards`, views, pages, flows). **Nothing fires that should not.** The one thing that changes shape downstream is the `--stored` outcome of an extension row with a refused key: `canonical` (0 TODOs) becomes `skipped` with one TODO per key (protocol.ts ~L16740-16745), which is the listing the card asked for.
6. **The detector lists exactly what the door refuses.** `refusedFieldPatchKeys` runs `ObjectExtensionSchema.safeParse` on the extension and keeps `invalid_key` issues at path length 2 under `fieldPatches`. The door is `fieldPatches: z.record(FieldNameKeySchema, …, { error })` (object.zod.ts L5057-5069) and `FieldNameKeySchema` is `/^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$/` (L2785). The `__c` refinement (L4902-4912) and the replaced-field refinement (L4929-4940) emit `custom` issues at the same path and are excluded, as the test pins; a patch's `options` invalid_key sits at path length 4 and is excluded. The ADR-0010 envelope a loader stamps would add `unrecognized_keys` issues only, which the filter drops, so a raw stored body judges the same as the save door's envelope-peeled parse. **Right.**
7. **Public surface.** No schema, no export: `REFUSED_STORED_SHAPES` and `STORED_ONLY_COLLECTIONS` are module-internal (`refused-shapes.ts` header: "not re-exported from `conversions/index.ts`"). The published shapes are the existing `ConversionNotice` and `ConversionTodoNotice`; one new TODO `conversionId` appears, which is additive. **Clause-②: no** holds. **Metadata-protocol: none** holds: no door accepts or refuses anything new.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/29554-stored-object-extension-rows.md`: `'@objectstack/spec': patch`, body carries `Clause-②: no (no accept set moves; the stored pass and the `--stored` listing widen)` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, matching the PR body and the claim. Precedent on `main` for a listing-only widening of the stored pass is `patch` (`.changeset/29212-dashboard-duplicate-filter-stored-listing.md`, `.changeset/28163-stored-connector-input-listed.md`, and the #25279 fix in packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md under "Patch Changes"). The diff publishes a behaviour fix on an existing primitive and one additive TODO id; `patch` is the right level. The body's claims were checked against the tree (①4-6) and none is false. **Matches.**

Clause-②: no (no accept set moves; the stored pass and the `--stored` listing widen) — confirmed in the tree.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev `open_questions` #1 — keep the correction of the PENDING `.changeset/29366-field-patches-key-grammar.md` (option A) or restore the base sentence (option B)?** Judged: **A is right and the correction is necessary.** The base sentence reads "`os migrate meta --stored` does not list such a row beforehand: the stored pass has no stack collection for an `object_extension` row and hands it back untouched, so check each stored extension's `fieldPatches` keys against the grammar before upgrading." Once this PR lands, every clause of it is false in the tree: the stored pass has a collection for the row (`stored.ts` L84), the row is not handed back untouched, and `--stored` lists each refused key. #29366's changeset is unreleased (it sits on the merge base in `.changeset/`), so both notes go into the same CHANGELOG entry; option B would publish a false instruction (do a manual check) one bullet away from a true one. The corrected sentence ("lists such a row beforehand, one TODO for each refused key at `fieldPatches.KEY`, and leaves it as stored for its owner to rename") matches what `objectExtensionFieldPatchKeyGrammar.detect` reports. This is the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class of `scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs` (L541-563, #18160 ruling D on #17712): the gate stays red by design and the only exit is a person's written confirmation on the PR. **Escalated to the maintainer** (statement below); the contract review does not and cannot clear it.
- **Check-run `Check Changeset` = failure.** Its annotation names `.changeset/29366-field-patches-key-grammar.md` and prints the two-class text; this is the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class above, not a collision (the PR adds its own changeset under a different, issue-scoped name). Red by design; not a defect in the hits files.
- **Check-runs still `in_progress` at both polls** (20:3x and later): Test Core 1-8/8, Type Check · workspace / consumer gates / source gates / debt ledger, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · CI/release & engine gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Build Core, Test UI 1-16. Concluded green: Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · scoped (three), Spec property liveness, Check PR Size, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Dogfood Regression Gate. This record's PASS is on the hits files; the derived test and type gates are the check-runs' to answer, and a red one among them is not overridden here.
- **Dev flag: the detector is appended last so spec seat 5's #29541 lands after it (additive).** Verified: `REFUSED_STORED_SHAPES` L641-651 ends with `objectExtensionFieldPatchKeyGrammar`, and the id-list test at refused-shapes.test.ts L73-77 ends with its id. #29541 has no PR yet (issue open, no head). Its card asks for its detector "beside `dashboardDuplicateGlobalFilterName`", i.e. inserted before this one, so seat 5 will hit a textual conflict on the array and on the id list; both are append-only edits with no ordering dependency between the two detectors, so the merge is mechanical. Answered.
- **Dev flag: no `protocol.ts` / `protocol.zod.ts` / `identity/protocol.ts` touched (freeze).** Verified on the file list: 7 files, none of the frozen three. Answered.
- **Dev flag: the `missing` waiver reason in `check-stack-collection-maps.mjs` is dated.** Confirmed at L539; noted, wording, outside scope (①2). Answered.
- **Docs drift bot names `content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx`.** Read: the page carries no `--stored` sentence (no `migrate meta --stored` in it, nor in `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`), so nothing there became false. Answered.

### ④ Design judgment

**`packages/spec/src/conversions/stored.ts` — holds.** One line in `STORED_ONLY_COLLECTIONS`, reached by the existing lookup (`PLURAL_TO_SINGULAR[type] ?? type` then `SINGULAR_TO_PLURAL[singular] ?? STORED_ONLY_COLLECTIONS[singular]`). Tried to break it: (a) a row stored under `objectExtensions` or `object_extensions` — neither map resolves it, so it passes by reference, and the `--stored` pass already reports it `skipped` by `isNonCanonicalStoredType` (both fold to `object_extension` in the URL map); the test pins both. (b) A row whose body is not a dict — the L144 guard returns it. (c) The `{ [collection]: [item] }` wrap with a one-element array — `mapCollection` indexes it as `objectExtensions[0]`, which is the path every notice and TODO carries; the resync and list reads discard the path and keep the item. (d) The doc comment's claim that the stored-metadata pass reports any other spelling as `skipped` before reading the body — true at protocol.ts ~L16575. No finding.

**`packages/spec/src/conversions/refused-shapes.ts` — holds.** `refusedFieldPatchKeys` is the door's own predicate (①6) and the detector reports one TODO per refused key at `${path}.fieldPatches.${key}` with `from` = that key's patch only (no credential surface: a display patch), `reason` naming the target by `extend` (falls back to "its target" when `extend` is not a string, which is also the case the parse refuses at `extend`), the no-lossless-rewrite argument, the sync's INVALID_METADATA consequence (true: `registrableObjectExtension` throws for the whole body, protocol-object-extension-item.ts L237-254), and closes with the parse's message. The callback returns the item unchanged, so `mapCollection` leaves the stack untouched (walk.ts L500-505). `toMajor: 18` and the id match the registered semantic entry, which the chain test asserts. Tried to break it: (a) a `__proto__` key — matches the grammar, refused by `refuseRecordProtoKey` with a non-`invalid_key` issue, not listed; the entry's surface is the grammar, so this is outside it, and the guard is #-numbered elsewhere; not a finding. (b) A key with a space — path `objectExtensions[0].fieldPatches.Annual Revenue`, same rendering the parse's `path.join('.')` gives and the test pins; consistent with other detectors. (c) Order sensitivity — none: each detector reports independently over the converted stack. No must-fix.

**`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.object-extension-field-patch-key-grammar-refused.ts` — holds.** The header comment and `acceptanceCriteria` now describe what the tree does: the stored pass wraps the row (stored.ts), the detector of this id lists each refused key "under its row" and "leaves it as stored" (the detector rewrites nothing; `--stored` reports `skipped` with the TODO when no conversion also fires, `pending` when one does, and `--apply` then fails at the save door, which is the documented behaviour of every refused shape that also converts).
